summary: The contract always contains exactly two already-running promises, so the bookkeeping is constant and correctness depends on observing both settlements and producing their numeric sum rather than on scalable workload growth.

workload_bound.source_constraint: the function receives exactly promise1 and promise2

replacement_checks.evidence: The implementation creates one fixed two-element collection, awaits it once, and performs one numeric addition regardless of promise durations.
Authored schedules cover either promise finishing last, equal delays, immediate values, negative values, zeros, and large magnitudes.
The deterministic adapter verifies the exact sum and that combined completion occurs at the maximum of the two settlement delays.
The exact native source is remotely Accepted under the provider timeout, and every authored two-promise schedule has a finite completion time.
